decisions.title: 2009 Fire General Obligation Bond Project Scopes
decisions.description: Details the 2009 Fire bond scopes for replacing outdated emergency response apparatus, rehabilitating fire stations, acquiring land for Station 9 expansion, and renovating Fire Station 2.

decisions.title: 2009–2017 Fire General Obligation Bond Summary
decisions.description: Schedules $22.9 million of Fire bond funding through 2017 for apparatus replacement, fire station rehabilitation, land acquisition for the Station 9 expansion, and renovation of Fire Station 2.

decisions.title: 2009 Police General Obligation Bond Project Scopes
decisions.description: Details the 2009 Police bond scopes, including the Sixth Area Command Phase II, marked police vehicle replacement, Cibola and Ellison facility work, and headquarters improvements.

decisions.title: 2009–2017 Police General Obligation Bond Summary
decisions.description: Schedules Police bond funding through 2017 for the Sixth Area Command Phase II, marked police vehicles, facility renovation, and related public safety capital investments.

decisions.title: 2009 Cultural Services General Obligation Bond Project Scopes
decisions.description: Details 2009 Cultural Services bond scopes across the Biological Park, museums, libraries, and cultural facilities, including paving, exhibits, a bonsai facility, International District work, and feasibility studies.

decisions.title: 2009 Council Neighborhood Set-Aside Project Scopes
decisions.description: Details nine pages of 2009 Council neighborhood set-aside project scopes by district, covering parks, alleys, beautification, amenities, economic development, and other district-specific neighborhood improvements.

decisions.title: 2009–2017 Council Neighborhood Set-Aside General Obligation Bond Summary
decisions.description: Schedules Council neighborhood set-aside bond funding through 2017 by district, covering park, alley, beautification, amenity, and neighborhood enhancement allocations across all Council districts.

decisions.title: 2009 Library General Obligation Bond Authorization
decisions.description: Preserves the 2009 library bond authorization sheet, covering design, equipping, and construction of library facilities, feasibility work, and the purchase of library materials and collections.

decisions.title: 2009 Senior, Family, Community Center, and Community Enhancement Project Bond Authorization
decisions.description: Preserves the 2009 authorization sheet for senior, family, and community center bonds and community enhancement projects, covering acquisition, design, construction, and equipping of community facilities.

decisions.title: 2009 Public Safety General Obligation Bond Authorization
decisions.description: Preserves the 2009 Public Safety bond authorization sheet, covering fire apparatus, the Sixth Area Command, Cibola facilities, and related police and fire capital purposes.

decisions.title: Urban Enhancement Trust Fund 2010–2011 Program Overview
decisions.description: Describes the Urban Enhancement Trust Fund program for 2010 and 2011, including the committee, selection criteria, decade-plan relationship, and the process for awarding community enhancement funding.

decisions.title: Urban Enhancement Trust Fund 2010–2011 Funding Summary
decisions.description: Summarizes Urban Enhancement Trust Fund allocations for the 2010 and 2011 cycle, recording the total program amount available for community enhancement awards.

decisions.title: Urban Enhancement Trust Fund 2010–2011 Funded Projects
decisions.description: Lists the Urban Enhancement Trust Fund projects funded for 2010 and 2011 across fourteen pages, naming each organization, project, and award amount for community, cultural, and educational enhancement work.

decisions.title: Development Process Manual Executive Committee Minutes, July 16, 2014
decisions.description: Establishes the committee's internal rules of procedure, adopting a six-member quorum, majority and unanimous voting thresholds, Open Meetings compliance, and a requirement that the Development Process Manual be amended to reflect recorded voting results.

decisions.title: Development Process Manual Executive Committee Minutes, December 17, 2014
decisions.description: Records adoption of the Development Process Manual preface and update procedure, removing references to two dissolved subcommittees, consolidating that authority in the Executive Committee, and approving related language changes by motion.
